t: The Fortress Trade 4" Interior Decorating 7-Piece Set provides a comprehensive solution for professional painting and decorating tasks. Ideal for precision work on trim, doors, and metal surfaces, this versatile kit ensures a high-quality finish across various applications. It includes a durable 4" roller frame, 2 x medium pile sleeves for emulsion, 2 x gloss sleeves for smooth finishes, and 2 x mohair sleeves for fine detail work. This set is engineered for compatibility with both water-based and oil-based paint types, offering flexibility on any job.
